instruction: Generate a GRUB configuration from scratch (no update-grub)
GRUB: chainload a Windows Boot Manager on UEFI
output:
cat >> /etc/grub.d/40_custom <<'EOF'
menuentry "Windows UEFI" {
  insmod part_gpt
  insmod fat
  search --fs-uuid --no-floppy --set=root XXXX-XXXX
  chainloader /EFI/Microsoft/Boot/bootmgfw.efi
}
EOF
update-grub

instruction: Create a systemd-boot entry for a fallback kernel
output:
cat > /boot/efi/loader/entries/debian-fallback.conf <<'EOF'
title Debian Fallback
linux /vmlinuz-fallback
initrd /initramfs-fallback.img
options root=UUID=xxx rw
EOF
